local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer
getgenv().SelectedRarities = {['All'] = true}
getgenv().SelectedBrainrots = {['All'] = true}
getgenv().AutoFarmEnabled = false

-- Robust String Utilities
local function trim(s)
    s = tostring(s or '')
    return (s:gsub('^%s*(.-)%s*$', '%1'))
end

local function stripTags(s)
    s = tostring(s or '')
    return (s:gsub('<[^>]->', ''))
end

local function cleanName(name)
    name = tostring(name or '')
    return (name:gsub('^%d+_', ''))
end

local function getGuiFolder()
    local gui = lp:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui')
    local main = gui and gui:FindFirstChild('MainScreen')
    local center = main and main:FindFirstChild('CenterScreen')
    local index = center and center:FindFirstChild('Index')
    return index and index:FindFirstChild('Scrolling')
end

-- Helper to get rarity text safely
local function getRarityText(button)
    local rarityObj = button:FindFirstChild('Rarity')
    if rarityObj and (rarityObj:IsA('TextLabel') or rarityObj:IsA('TextBox')) then
        return trim(stripTags(rarityObj.Text))
    end
    return nil
end

local function getRarities()
    local rarities = {'All'}
    local seen = {}
    local folder = getGuiFolder()
    if folder then
        for _, v in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA('ImageButton') then
                local rarity = getRarityText(v)
                if rarity and rarity ~= '' and not seen[rarity] then
                    table.insert(rarities, rarity)
                    seen[rarity] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return rarities
end

local function getBrainrots(selectedRarities)
    local list = {'All'}
    local seen = {}
    local folder = getGuiFolder()
    if folder then
        for _, v in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA('ImageButton') then
                local rarity = getRarityText(v)
                local isAll = selectedRarities['All']
                local rarityMatch = isAll

                if not rarityMatch and rarity then
                    for selRarity, enabled in pairs(selectedRarities) do
                        if enabled and string.lower(trim(selRarity)) == string.lower(trim(rarity)) then
                            rarityMatch = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end

                if rarityMatch then
                    local cleaned = cleanName(v.Name)
                    if not seen[cleaned] then
                        table.insert(list, cleaned)
                        seen[cleaned] = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return list
end

local brainrotDrop

Value:AddDropdown('RaritySelector', {
    Title = 'Select Rarity',
    Values = getRarities(),
    Default = {'All'},
    Multi = true,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().SelectedRarities = V
        local newBrainrots = getBrainrots(V)
        if brainrotDrop then
            pcall(function()
                brainrotDrop:SetValues(newBrainrots)
            end)
        end
    end
})

brainrotDrop = Value:AddDropdown('BrainrotSelector', {
    Title = 'Select Brainrots',
    Values = getBrainrots({['All'] = true}),
    Default = {'All'},
    Multi = true,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().SelectedBrainrots = V
    end
})

local function getRoot()
    return lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
end

local function isHolding()
    local gui = lp:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui')
    local main = gui and gui:FindFirstChild('MainScreen')
    local center = main and main:FindFirstChild('CenterScreen')
    local holding = center and center:FindFirstChild('HoldingBrainrot')
    return holding and holding.Visible
end

-- Robust Target Check
local function isTarget(entity)
    if entity:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') then return false end

    local charIdAttr = entity:GetAttribute('CharacterId')
    if not charIdAttr then return false end
    local charId = tostring(charIdAttr)
    local cleanedCharId = cleanName(charId)
    
    -- Find the corresponding button in the UI to get its rarity
    local folder = getGuiFolder()
    local targetRarity = nil
    
    if folder then
        for _, v in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA('ImageButton') then
                -- Match by full name OR cleaned name
                if tostring(v.Name) == charId or cleanName(v.Name) == cleanedCharId then
                    targetRarity = getRarityText(v)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Rarity Check
    local rarityMatch = false
    if getgenv().SelectedRarities['All'] then
        rarityMatch = true
    elseif targetRarity then
        for selRarity, enabled in pairs(getgenv().SelectedRarities) do
            if enabled and string.lower(trim(selRarity)) == string.lower(trim(targetRarity)) then
                rarityMatch = true
                break
            end
        end
    end

    if not rarityMatch then return false end

    -- Brainrot Check
    local brainrotMatch = false
    if getgenv().SelectedBrainrots['All'] then
        brainrotMatch = true
    else
        for selBr, enabled in pairs(getgenv().SelectedBrainrots) do
            if enabled and string.lower(trim(selBr)) == string.lower(trim(cleanedCharId)) then
                brainrotMatch = true
                break
            end
        end
    end
    
    return brainrotMatch
end

Value:AddToggle('FarmToggle', {
    Title = 'Auto Take',
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().AutoFarmEnabled = V
        if V then
            task.spawn(function()
                while getgenv().AutoFarmEnabled do
                    pcall(function()
                        if lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') and lp.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                            if isHolding() then
                                local root = getRoot()
                                if root then
                                    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(-429, 1330, -325)
                                end
                                task.wait(0.5)
                            else
                                local entities = workspace:FindFirstChild('SpawnedEntities')
                                local target = nil
                                if entities then
                                    for _, ent in ipairs(entities:GetChildren()) do
                                        if isTarget(ent) then
                                            target = ent
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end

                                if target then
                                    local root = getRoot()
                                    if root then
                                        -- Teleport First (stay stuck to it)
                                        root.CFrame = target:GetPivot()
                                        
                                        -- Wait for MeshPart to appear (Robust check)
                                        local mesh = target:FindFirstChildOfClass('MeshPart') or target:FindFirstChildOfClass('BasePart')
                                        local start = os.clock()
                                        while not mesh and (os.clock() - start) < 6 and getgenv().AutoFarmEnabled do
                                            task.wait(0.1)
                                            mesh = target:FindFirstChildOfClass('MeshPart') or target:FindFirstChildOfClass('BasePart')
                                            if not target.Parent then break end
                                            root.CFrame = target:GetPivot()
                                        end

                                        if mesh then
                                            local prompt = target:FindFirstChild('PickupPrompt', true) or target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('ProximityPrompt', true)
                                            if prompt then
                                                root.CFrame = mesh.CFrame
                                                fireproximityprompt(prompt)
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                    task.wait(0.1)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
})

getgenv().AutoCollectPlot = false
local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer

Value:AddToggle('PlotCollectToggle', {
    Title = 'Auto Plot Collect',
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        getgenv().AutoCollectPlot = v
        if v then
            task.spawn(function()
                while getgenv().AutoCollectPlot do
                    pcall(function()
                        local playerPlot = nil
                        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("World") and workspace.World:FindFirstChild("Plots")
                        if plots then
                            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                                if tostring(plot:GetAttribute("OwnerId")) == tostring(lp.UserId) then
                                    playerPlot = plot
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        if playerPlot then
                            local floors = playerPlot:FindFirstChild("Floors")
                            if floors then
                                for _, floor in ipairs(floors:GetChildren()) do
                                    local stands = floor:FindFirstChild("Stands")
                                    if stands then
                                        for _, stand in ipairs(stands:GetChildren()) do
                                            local main = stand:FindFirstChild("Button") and stand.Button:FindFirstChild("Main")
                                            if main and main:GetAttribute("HasCharacter") == true then
                                                local touch = main:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest")
                                                local root = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                                if touch and root then
                                                    firetouchinterest(root, main, 0)
                                                    task.wait(0.1)
                                                    firetouchinterest(root, main, 1)
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                    task.wait(1)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
})
